subject: general
question: Suresh starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards the east. He then takes a left tum, drives 4 km, turns right and drives 5 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 10 km, takes a right tum and drives 8 km. He then takes right tum and drives 13 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point B. How far and towards which direction should be drive in order to reach Point A from Point B? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Given: All turns are 90 degree turns only

Suresh starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards the east.

He then takes a left tum, drives 4 km, turns right and drives 5 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 10 km, takes a right tum and drives 8 km.

He then takes right tum and drives 13 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c865f6b7040e6565c83217c2affa52526e1d9179aa6b4482a7fc010a7acecefa.png] 

Thus, Suresh should drive (13 km - 4 km) = 7 km in south direction in order to reach Point A from Point B.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
